skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and differentiate basic concepts of IT projects, apply project management knowledge to manage IT projects, distinguish functions and tasks of a project manager, and manage project phases and areas.
Develop leadership skills to organize and lead project teams, manage project progress, quality, communication, and risks.
Improve communication skills for effective project management, including report writing and presentation.
Apply problem-solving skills to analyze and resolve issues related to IT projects.
Enhance teamwork skills, understand responsibilities, and professional ethics.
Develop independent learning skills to research and complete assignments.
Improve critical thinking skills to evaluate and manage IT projects effectively.
Use software tools like Microsoft Project, Jira, and Trello to manage IT projects.
